test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a triangle ABC, CA is produced to P, ∠ BAP = 126°. If ∠ABC ∶ ∠ACB = 5 ∶ 2, the degree measures of ∠B and ∠C are respectively:
solution:
**Given:**

∠ BAP = 126° 

∠ABC : ∠ACB = 5 : 2

**Formula used:**

The sum of all the angles of a triangle is 180°

∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180° 

The sum of the angles in a straight line is 180° 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd595cb30f9c254d1c1294136c986bbdc02286587a438b007bac6a28bb070fa9.png] 

Let ∠ABC = 5x; ∠ACB = 2x

As CA is produced to P 

⇒ ∠BAC + ∠BAP = 180° (sum of the angles in a straight line = 180° )

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° - ∠BAP

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° - 126° = 54° 

In △ ABC

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 5x + 2x + 54 = 180

⇒ 7x = 126 

⇒ x = 18** **

So, angle B = 5x = 5 × 18 = 90° 

Angle C = 2x = 2 × 18 = 36°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°, 36°.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

**Concept Used:**

The exterior angle theorem, 

According to the figure: 

We know that, 

∠ ABC + ∠ ACB = ∠ BAP

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd595cb30f9c254d1c1294136c986bbdc02286587a438b007bac6a28bb070fa9.png] 

⇒ ∠ ABC + ∠ ACB = ∠ BAP

⇒ 5x + 2x = 126°

⇒ 7x = 126°

⇒ x = 126°/7 = 18°

Now, 

∠ B = 5x = 5 × 18 = 90° 

∠ C = 2x = 2 × 18 = 36° 

∴ Angle B is 90° and angle C is 36° .
